summary.text: Rebekah Stewart is a Democrat who represents District 30 (Jefferson County) in the Colorado House of Representatives, where she took office on January 8, 2025; Ballotpedia lists her as running for re-election in 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia says she earned a graduate degree from the University of Missouri-Kansas City in 2011 and has worked as a therapist and as director of finance and operations for a nonprofit.
